text:
Alex: kicking off phased launch for rwd-infer v3.2. Plan: US (canary 5%) -> EU (canary 10%) -> APAC (staged). Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Pinning traffic rules and rollback triggers now.

deploy-bot: [deploy init] starting canary in region us-east1
```sh
deploy start --service rwd-infer --version v3.2 --region us-east1 --canary 5
``` 

Maya: running quick capacity checks: warm pool 48/50, gpu util avg 61%, headroom ~22%. p50=38ms p95=185ms

Jun: i'll watch the dashboards. Alert thresholds: p95>220ms OR errors>0.8% sustained 3m -> escalate/rollback. @oncall-sre

Alex: rollback command if needed:
```sh
deploy rollback --service rwd-infer --to v3.1 --force-pin
```

deploy-bot: canary in us-east1 reporting metrics:
- p95=182ms, errors=0.21%, qps=1.2k
- kv-cache hit 73%

Maya: perf looks good in US. doing log-sample checks for hallucination regression (50 prompts) :thumbsup:

Sophie: release notes posted: https://confluence.redwood/c/rwd-infer/v3.2-release - note: EU KMS flag must be toggled in private plane. cc: infra

deploy-bot: initiating EU canary (europe-west1) at +18m: canary 10%
```sh
deploy start --service rwd-infer --version v3.2 --region europe-west1 --canary 10
```

deploy-bot: EU metrics (initial 6m): p95=195ms, errors=0.35%, qps=980

Jun: EU p95 still < 220ms, errors < 0.8%. proceeding with gradual ramp to 40% after +20m if stable.

Alex: decision on APAC: hold APAC until we confirm EU ramp and check gpu quotas in ap-south1. If any thermal throttling or scaling lag, we delay APAC and schedule a secondary window at 10:00 UTC.

Maya: noticed APAC infra quota at 68% used; if EU ramps to 60% we might hit 85% overall. Recommend provisioning 4 extra warm nodes before APAC go.

Sophie: ops note added to release doc. tagging partnerships to confirm capacity purchase lead time.

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 40% complete. Metrics snapshot:
- p95=202ms, errors=0.5%, qps=3.6k

Jun: green to proceed to full US/EU ramp to 100% in slices (20% steps, 3m observation). APAC remains on hold until infra confirms extra nodes.

Alex: final decision: ramp US/EU to 100% over next 30m. APAC hold — create ticket INFRA-4532 to provision GPUs and re-run APAC canary after confirmation. Rollback triggers reiterated: p95>300ms OR errors>1.0% for 5m -> immediate rollback to v3.1.

Maya: ACK. I'll monitor logs and open INFRA-4532. ping me on pager if anything crosses threshold.

Jun: monitoring. I'll update incident channel if any blips. :white_check_mark:

Sophie: adding post-deploy checklist: gather perf samples, eval prompts, customer-facing notes. Will update release notes with APAC lag.

Alex: thanks everyone. tagging @deploy-bot to mark release notes pinned and close thread when APAC done.

deploy-bot: release notes pinned to channel. canary windows logged.
